metadata.marketNotes: 2026 values reflect continued strength in oncology licensing, with radiopharmaceutical and ADC deals driving premiums. Neurology/CNS added as second therapeutic area, calibrated against 88 R&D partnerships totaling $45.9B (2024-Q2 2025). CNS resurgence driven by BBB delivery platforms, muscarinic agonists, and renewed Alzheimer's investment.

interactionTerms._description: Modality × indication synergy bonuses that replace simple multiplication. Applied as additive bonus to the combined multiplier.

bbbPlatform+alzheimers.context: BBB platform + AD is the premier combo: multi-program optionality in largest CNS market

bbbPlatform+parkinsons.context: BBB crossing critical for PD targets (alpha-synuclein, LRRK2)

aso+huntingtons.context: ASO is the leading modality for HD (allele-selective silencing); Wave, uniQure, Ionis

aso+als.context: ASO validated in ALS (tofersen/SOD1); genetic subtype targeting

geneTherapy+rareNeuro.context: Gene therapy + rare CNS is curative potential; Zolgensma precedent; monogenic validation

geneTherapy+huntingtons.context: One-time gene therapy for HD; uniQure AMT-130 benchmark

geneTherapy+epilepsy.context: Gene therapy for rare epilepsy syndromes; Dravet, Angelman interest

tauTargeting+alzheimers.context: Tau is the next wave after amyloid validation; tau PET-guided treatment

psychedelic+depression.context: Psychedelic + MDD is the prime use case; psilocybin, MDMA-assisted, neuroplastogens

ionChannel+epilepsy.context: Ion channels are validated targets in epilepsy; genetic epilepsy syndromes

ionChannel+pain.context: Nav1.8 is a validated non-opioid pain target; Vertex precedent

stemCell+parkinsons.context: Dopaminergic neuron replacement is the holy grail for PD; BlueRock/Bayer lead

stemCell+tbi.context: Neural progenitors for brain injury repair; emerging neuroprotection

neurologyDiseaseModifyingPhaseAdjustment._description: Disease-modifying neurology assets have longer development timelines. These multipliers adjust milestone allocations to weight development milestones higher.

ADCs remain hot - Merck, Pfizer, others actively acquiring

modality.radiopharmaceutical: Radiopharmaceuticals are commanding 50-60% premiums in 2025. Leverage the Point/RayzeBio deals as comparables.
modality.adc: ADCs remain highly sought after. Push for higher upfront given Merck, Pfizer acquisition activity.
modality.bispecific: Bispecific T-cell engagers are accelerating. Highlight differentiated safety/efficacy profile.
modality.protac: PROTAC/degrader deals continue strong. Emphasize oral bioavailability and target coverage.
modality.molecularGlue: Molecular glues are a hot emerging category. Novel targets can command premium.
modality.geneTherapy: Gene therapy valuations cooling due to manufacturing/durability concerns. Expect scrutiny on CMC.
modality.carT_heme: CAR-T in heme is maturing. Manufacturing cost and vein-to-vein time are key negotiation points.

lineOfTherapy.1L: First-line potential significantly increases value. Emphasize 1L pathway and unmet need in discussions.
lineOfTherapy.3L+: Third-line+ positioning limits peak sales potential. Consider demonstrating combo or earlier-line potential.

competitivePosition.firstInClass: First-in-class mechanism provides significant leverage. Emphasize novel biology and lack of alternatives.
competitivePosition.crowded: Crowded competitive space - expect pushback on royalties. Consider flexibility on milestones.
competitivePosition.behind: Behind competitors - focus on differentiation (safety, convenience, combo potential) to justify terms.

territory.china: China rights increasingly carved out due to geopolitical uncertainty. Consider geographic splits.
territory.europe: IRA creating pressure on EU-only value. US rights are key driver - consider split deals.

dataQuality.pivotalReady: Pivotal-ready data significantly de-risks the asset. Push for premium upfront.
dataQuality.limited: Limited data increases risk profile. Expect milestone-heavy structure with lower upfront.

regulatory.breakthrough: Breakthrough designation adds credibility and expedited pathway. Use as negotiation leverage.

neurologyModality.bbbPlatform: BBB delivery platforms command 2-3x premiums due to multi-program optionality. Leverage AZ/JCR ($825M) and ABL/GSK ($2.7B) as comparables.
neurologyModality.aso: ASOs have a proven regulatory path in neuro (Spinraza precedent). Emphasize genetic target validation and manufacturing scalability.
neurologyModality.psychedelic: Psychedelic/neuroplastogen deals are nascent but high-value. AbbVie/Gilgamesh ($1.2B) sets the benchmark for differentiated Phase 2 assets.
neurologyModality.geneTherapy: CNS gene therapy commands higher premiums than oncology gene therapy due to curative potential for monogenic disorders. Expect scrutiny on BBB penetration and durability.
neurologyModality.ionChannel: Ion channel modulators are gaining traction in epilepsy and pain. Nav1.8 (Vertex precedent) and genetic epilepsy channels command differentiated terms. Emphasize selectivity data.
neurologyModality.tauTargeting: Tau-targeting therapies are the next wave after amyloid validation. Tau PET-guided patient selection and disease modification data are key negotiation leverage points.
neurologyModality.stemCell: Neural stem cell/progenitor therapies command premiums for curative potential. BlueRock/Bayer ($1B+) sets the benchmark. CMC and scalability are critical discussion points.

neurologyIndication.alzheimers: Alzheimer's commands the highest CNS premiums. Anti-amyloid approvals validated the space. BBB-crossing assets at significant premium.
neurologyIndication.schizophrenia: Schizophrenia deals reset by KarXT/Cobenfy approval. Novel mechanisms (muscarinic agonists) commanding premium over D2-based approaches.
neurologyIndication.als: ALS carries maximum orphan premiums with critical unmet need. ASO/gene therapy approaches lead. Biogen/Ionis tofersen (SOD1) validates genetic targeting in ALS.
neurologyIndication.huntingtons: Huntington's is a validated genetic target with orphan premiums. Novartis/PTC $1B upfront sets the benchmark. Allele-selective silencing commands premium.
neurologyIndication.narcolepsy: Narcolepsy is an orphan-adjacent market dominated by Jazz and Harmony. Orexin biology expanding. Novel mechanisms can command premium for differentiation.
neurologyIndication.epilepsy: Epilepsy gene therapy and ion channel approaches attract orphan premiums for rare epilepsy syndromes. Broad epilepsy is competitive — differentiate on mechanism.
neurologyIndication.tbi: TBI/stroke recovery has zero approved disease-modifying treatments. Massive unmet need but regulatory path uncertain. Neuroprotection/regeneration data is key.
neurologyIndication.depression: MDD is a large but competitive market. Differentiation (novel MOA, rapid onset, reduced side effects) is critical for premium terms.
neurologyIndication.rareNeuro: Rare neurological diseases carry orphan drug premiums. Gene therapy and ASO approaches for monogenic CNS disorders can command curative-potential premiums.

treatmentApproach.diseaseModifying: Disease-modifying status significantly increases value in neurodegeneration. Emphasize biomarker evidence of disease modification in negotiations.
treatmentApproach.adjunctive: Adjunctive positioning limits standalone commercial potential. Consider demonstrating disease-modifying potential or earlier-line data.
